# Rohan Ekam Balewadi, Pune

> Rohan Ekam is a landmark 13-acre luxury riverfront residential development situated along the Mula River behind Balewadi High Street in Balewadi, Pune (PIN 411045). Conceptualized by Rohan Builders (India) Pvt. Ltd. and celebrated master architect Ar. Sanjay Mohe (Mindspace Architects), the project introduces India's first Ground Floor in the Sky at Level 14.

## Overview & Key Facts
- Developer: Rohan Builders (India) Pvt. Ltd. (30+ years engineering pedigree, CRISIL DA2+ developer rating)
- Architecture: Ar. Sanjay Mohe (Mindspace Architects)
- Total Masterplan: 13 Contiguous Acres along Mula River
- Density: 9 Boutique Towers with over 80% open landscaped greens
- Unique Feature: Level 14 "Ground Floor in the Sky" connecting all towers with continuous elevated sky bridges, sky jogging tracks, and pavilions
- Design Science: Rohan PLUS Homes (Perfect Ventilation, Lively Light, Utmost Privacy, Smart Space) with zero corridor wastage
- Configurations: 2 BHK, 3 BHK (Type 1 & Type 2), 4 BHK Sky Suite Duplex Penthouses
- Price Range: Starting ₹1.45 Cr* to ₹3.10 Cr* (plus statutory taxes)
- Possession: December 2027 onwards (Phase 1)
- MahaRERA Phase 1: P52100052298
- MahaRERA Phase 2: PR1261012502532
- Authorized Channel Partner: Propsmart Realty (MahaRERA: A031262401295)
- Advisory Desk: +91 774409295 / propsmartrealty@gmail.com
